wholePhysicalScope: Twenty-two-point museum footprint, surveyed entrance node, September 2024 cleared Qualla photograph and the Istanbul museum description.
lodDetails: All levels retain the round hall and slanted glazed frontage under the timber canopy. Close viewing adds door frames, deep mullions and timber bracing.
limitations: The September 2024 reconstruction covers the public glass entrance and connected exhibition hall. Exterior sculpture, cannon displays, signage lettering and interiors are outside its scope.

The cleared photo constrains the glazing, timber soffit, bracing and entrance canopy. The lower hall follows the mapped perimeter, with its unphotographed external roof surface and rear wall simplified.
Municipal sources give a 38 metre diameter for the interior panorama. The exterior crown is an approximate roof profile.
